<x_0.373><y_0.1906>Northwind Return Policy<x_0.626><y_0.2102><class_Section-header>

<x_0.2256><y_0.218># Restocking fees<x_0.3916><y_0.2375><class_Section-header>

<x_0.2256><y_0.2445>Northwind Retail accepts returns of unused merchandise with a receipt. A restocking fee applies to
opened electronics and assembled furniture, as the table below shows. This policy is synthetic.<x_0.749><y_0.2672><class_Text>

<x_0.3652><y_0.2773>\begin{tabular}{ccc}
**Category** & **Return window** & **Restocking fee**\\
Electronics & 15 days & 15\%\\
Furniture & 30 days & 10\%\\
Apparel & 60 days & None\\
\end{tabular}<x_0.6328><y_0.3516><class_Table>
